checks: Original V2 fixture builders and captured dependencies are reused; imports that create VMs occur only after the candidate hash and reviewed plan gates.
The capture wrapper records complete before/after account state, Clock, serialized transaction and verified signatures, while checking base vault/user/mint preserved before execution.
Original and candidate execute identical transaction bytes, Clock and prestates; errors/state/CPI/events/return values and ordered ordinary logs are compared.
Missing old executable data is unknown, not a difference. Hex/base64 ambiguity is conservative. Negative controls verify missing-data and encoding cases.
Novelty requires a known prestate/Clock difference for every colliding transaction; any unknown prevents a final distinct count.
limits: No VM execution by reviewer. Actual output and full dedup still require independent review.
This review covers only the twelve approved normal-owner inputs and is not generalized behavioral completeness.
